snippet.title: Denshattack! - Accolades Trailer
snippet.description:
"Irreverent, unpredictable, funny, and unputdownable" - Eurogamer, 5/5

We're incredibly humbled by all the love and support everyone has shown Denshattack! since it's launch! We want to extend a HUGE thank you to you all from the bottom of our hearts ❤️ We hope you continue to enjoy playing this wild train tricking adventure!

Denshattack! is available now on Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2524850/Denshattack/
